title: Continuous versus binary retrieval diagnosis for learned state addressing
question: Does the failure of the learned binary state index arise primarily from the learned semantic representation or from continuous-to-binary quantization and bucket probing?
hypothesis: H_diag: if the same trained encoder recovers held-out targets with continuous exhaustive scoring but the binary index does not, the dominant failure boundary is the discrete index; if both continuous and binary retrieval are poor, the learned representation is the limiting boundary.

arms.name: no_learning_continuous
arms.intervention: random frozen dual encoder with continuous exhaustive state scoring

arms.name: learned_continuous
arms.intervention: trained dual encoder with continuous exhaustive state scoring

arms.name: learned_binary
arms.intervention: same trained encoder with 8-bit sign quantization, radius-1 bucket probing and K=1

endpoints.name: continuous_state_score_macs
endpoints.role: audit — continuous exhaustive scoring arithmetic per query

endpoints.name: binary_probe_count
endpoints.role: audit — binary index dictionary probes per query

endpoints.name: continuous_target_rank
endpoints.role: secondary — rank of correct state under continuous scoring

decision_rule.condition: learned_continuous recall exceeds no_learning_continuous recall and learned_binary recall is at least 0.20 below learned_continuous recall
decision_rule.licenses: the current learned model contains usable semantic signal, while the registered binary retrieval boundary materially loses that signal
decision_rule.does_not_license: general learned indexing or semantic memory

decision_rule.condition: learned_continuous recall does not exceed no_learning_continuous recall
decision_rule.licenses: the current learned representation does not demonstrate held-out semantic state retrieval under the registered continuous scoring test
decision_rule.does_not_license: that learned semantic addressing is impossible

decision_rule.condition: learned_continuous recall exceeds no_learning_continuous recall and learned_binary recall is within 0.20 of learned_continuous recall
decision_rule.licenses: the observed C5-LEARNED-STATE-001 loss is not primarily explained by the registered binary quantization boundary

held_constant: same dual linear 10->8 encoder and 32-epoch training as C5-LEARNED-STATE-001
same H-invariant query/state generation amendment A1
binary arm uses the exact learned index parameters from C5-LEARNED-STATE-001
no evaluation address or gold target enters training
prior C5 and REP evidence remains frozen
